global_style: Opulent Art Deco glamour; warm golden palette; shallow depth of field; smooth camera glide; exterior night fireworks backlight; romantic nostalgia.

narrative_layer.narrative_action: The camera glides past blurred partygoers to the back of a tuxedoed man as golden fireworks erupt; he slowly turns, breaks into a rare magnetic smile, and raises a crystal champagne coupe in a silent toast.

consistency_constraints: COLOR_PALETTE: Warm golds and champagne tones
LIGHTING: Fireworks backlight with warm fill
Maintain shallow depth of field — background partygoers remain blurred bokeh
Subtle rack focus to Gatsby during his turn and toast
Camera maintains slight low angle to place fireworks in the sky behind Gatsby
Gatsby remains framed center throughout the shot
